concerns.text: The plan acknowledges a critical data gap – no verified source provides both SMILES and FQY values. While two mitigation options are listed (scope revision or a deterministic join), the plan does not specify how the join key will be validated, nor does it provide a concrete fallback dataset. Without a reliable joint dataset, the core predictive modeling cannot be executed, threatening the ability to answer the research question.

The sample‑size justification is limited to an assumed minimum of 500 molecules. No formal power analysis is presented to show that this size is sufficient to detect the expected effect size (e.g., R² ≥ 0.7). If the eventual joint dataset is smaller, the study may be under‑powered, compromising the validity of the reported performance metrics.
